Chaithra K S

Bengaluru, Karnataka | +(91)-9108915434 | chaithraksguptha97@gmail.com

ServiceNow Developer

ServiceNow Developer | 4 Years | ITSM | JavaScript | GlideRecord | GlideAjax | Service Catalog | Flow Designer | REST API | CMDB

ServiceNow Developer with 4 years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow development, administration, ITSM, workflow automation, and integrations. Skilled in JavaScript, GlideRecord, GlideAjax, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, Service Catalog, Flow Designer, CMDB, REST APIs and ACLs. Experienced in developing Scoped Applications, Catalog Items, approval workflows, integrations, dashboards, and automated processes. Strong experience in Incident, Problem, Change, and Request Management. Worked 1.5 years onsite in Japan with international clients and stakeholders.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Fujitsu Consulting India Pvt. Ltd. – Bengaluru and Chennai

Technical Services Trainee | Assistant Technical Services Engineer Sep 2021 – Dec 2022 | Jun 2024 – Dec 2025

Developed Scoped Applications with custom tables, fields, relationships, and business logic.  Created and customized Service Catalog Items, dynamic variables, and approval workflows.  Developed Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, and Scheduled Jobs using JavaScript and Glide APIs. Implemented Flow Designer and Subflows for asset provisioning and decommissioning.

 Developed REST API integrations with external vendor/procurement systems.  Created reports and dashboards for asset managers and stakeholders.  Performed ServiceNow development, troubleshooting, testing, and production support.  Collaborated with global teams and stakeholders to deliver ServiceNow solutions. Fujitsu Limited – Japan

System Engineer | ServiceNow Administrator/Developer Dec 2022 – May 2024 | Tokyo & Shiga, Japan

Administered ServiceNow ITSM modules including Incident, Problem, Change, and Request.  Managed users, groups, roles, ACLs, RBAC, and data policies.  Configured Service Catalog, Business Rules, Client Scripts, and UI Policies.  Managed CMDB, CI relationships, data imports, and data quality.  Supported ServiceNow upgrades, patches, platform maintenance, and troubleshooting.  Created reports and dashboards for management and operational teams.  Supported integrations with Active Directory, email systems, and third-party tools.  Worked onsite with Japanese clients and international stakeholders for ServiceNow support and implementation.

Chaithra K S

chaithraksguptha97@gmail.com

Cross-Cultural Communication: Worked with Japanese clients for 1.5 years and supported global teams. ● Problem Solving: Fixed complex issues in workflows, improving incident resolution. ● Team Collaboration: Helped team members during upgrades and development sprints. ● Adaptability: Adjusted quickly to new environments and earned new tools and processes.
